import sys
import math

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().splitlines()
    
    n = int(data[0].strip())
    if n > 11:
        print("0")
        return
    
    points = []
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        coords = list(map(int, data[i].split()))
        points.append(coords)
    
    good_indices = set()
    
    for i in range(n):
        is_good = True
        for j in range(n):
            if not is_good:
                break
            for k in range(n):
                if not is_good:
                    break
                if i != j and i != k and j != k:
                    v1 = [points[j][p] - points[i][p] for p in range(5)]
                    v2 = [points[k][p] - points[i][p] for p in range(5)]
                    dot = sum(v1[p] * v2[p] for p in range(5))
                    if dot > 0:
                        is_good = False
        if is_good:
            good_indices.add(i + 1)
    
    if not good_indices:
        print("0")
    else:
        print(len(good_indices))
        for idx in sorted(good_indices):
            print(idx)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
